# Nordic region

Region: Europe. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Nordic Payments Council

**Role:** Regional credit-transfer scheme and market-practice body

**Reporting coverage:** CAMT052/053/054 customer-reporting recommendation

**Messages / versions:** camt.052.001.08; camt.053.001.08; camt.054.001.08; pain; pacs

- [NPC NCT scheme rulebook and implementation guidelines](https://www.nordicpaymentscouncil.org/npc-schemes/npc-credit-transfer-scheme-rulebook/) — specification; public-page
- [NPC004-01 reporting recommendation 2025 version1.0](https://www.nordicpaymentscouncil.org/media/w4cpr1sg/npc004-01-recommendation-on-customer-reporting-nct-and-nct-inst-2025-version-10.pdf) — specification; public-file

40-page reporting recommendation maps NCT and NCT Inst data to CAMT052/053/054 v8. Participants are recommended to support it; it is not proof that every Nordic bank offers every format. Scheme version 2025 entered effect on 2025-10-05; operational readiness differs by participant and CSM.
